name: Lisa
source:
She's an excellent student and a smart girl, but first of all, she's just an ordinary teenage girl. Lisa loves Russian literature, Soviet cinema and cartoons about fairies very much.

Unfortunately, Lisa doesn't know much about computers. And yet, she really wants to play the new game that all her friends are talking about... 

[Translated from [url=https://tezuka-alex.itch.io/2ndcd]itch.io[/url]]
